summary: Build practical grid modernisation skills with reliability metrics, DER planning, and smart grid roadmaps. Enrol in this 5-day course.
lede: Grid modernisation applies digital monitoring and automation to improve how electricity networks are operated and adapted. For utility and power-system professionals, this course develops practical skills in grid maturity assessment, reliability KPI analysis, load forecasting and hosting-capacity assessment, alongside planning for distributed energy resources, outage improvements, resilience and phased investment.
audienceIntro: This advanced grid modernisation and smart grids course is built for professionals who plan, operate, analyse, or govern utility grid transformation and need practical artefacts they can use immediately.
prerequisites: To get the most from this advanced grid modernisation and smart grids course, you should have working knowledge of electrical distribution or transmission operations, utility planning, asset management, or power-system analysis. Prior exposure to concepts such as distributed energy resources, outage management systems, SCADA, or load forecasting will help you move faster, but you do not need coding skills to complete the course. You should bring a laptop for spreadsheet-based exercises, and if your organisation has current reliability, outage, or feeder data, that will strengthen the applied exercises. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational and implementation-planning level, not as engineering design for live deployment.
